title: Chapter 744 - 744 Tyrant; Bodhi Fruit!

Chapter 744 - 744 Tyrant; Bodhi Fruit!

Chapter 744 - 744 Tyrant; Bodhi Fruit!

744 Tyrant; Bodhi Fruit!

Lin Fan had a good impression of Kathleen.

She was beautiful and kind-hearted, just like a fairy.

Seeing that she was in danger, Lin Fan’s gaze could not help but stop.

In the blink of an eye, two days had passed.

One day ago, Kathleen’s name finally stopped flashing.

She had survived the crisis.

However, Lin Fan still had to wait for another day before using his soul to communicate with her.

“Kathleen.”

Kathleen was obviously stunned for a moment. After a while, she said,” You are…Lin Fan?”

Lin Fan said,” It’s me.”

“Is this a voice transmission technique? Are you near my Temple of Life?” There was an inexplicable fluctuation in Kathleen’s tone. It was surprise and joy!

Lin Fan replied,” From a certain perspective, this is indeed a voice transmission technique. However, I’m not near the Temple of Life. I’m in the Four Seasons Universe.””

Four Seasons Universe?

Kathleen was shocked.

She naturally knew about the Four Seasons Universe, especially in the past hundred years. There was an endless stream of news about the Four Seasons Universe.

However, wasn’t the Four Seasons Universe three universes away from the Temple of Life?

Lin Fan’s voice transmission crossed three universes and penetrated through the array formation of the Temple of Life?

This… This…

Then, she thought of Lin Fan’s figure that was moving forward in the River of Time. She thought of the powerful skill that Lin Fan had imparted to her, and the voice transmission that she had just received…

Just what realm had Lin Fan’s cultivation state reached?

Lin Fan said,” You encountered danger earlier?””

After hearing this, Kathleen finally came back to her senses.

She sighed and said,”Yes, I was injured by another saintess.””

It turned out that there were a total of 19 Holy Sons and Saintesses in the Temple of Life.

Most Holy Sons and Saintesses liked to put on a good show and wanted to become the Shrine Master of the Life Shrine.

On the other hand, Kathleen was an ordinary Saintess who didn’t have any thoughts about the Temple Master of the Temple of Life.

Because of this, many Holy Sons and Holy Maidens had a good relationship with her.

However, 100 years ago, Lin Fan had taught Kailin Revival, which had allowed her cultivation and life force to soar by leaps and bounds. This had attracted the attention of the Hall Master and many of the Grand Elders.

This change caused the Holy Sons and Holy Maidens who had a good relationship with her to distance themselves from her. They even began to be jealous of her, hate her, and suppress her.

Not long ago, in the secret realm of the Temple of Life, Kathleen was besieged by several Saints and Saintesses, causing her to be seriously injured.

After Lin Fan found out about this, he couldn’t help but say,””I didn’t expect that teaching you a cultivation technique would actually bring you so much trouble.”

” No,” Kathleen said,” it’s not because of you. I trusted them too much in the past.” Even if you don’t teach me the cultivation technique, if there’s a conflict of interest with them in the future, similar things will happen.”

“Moreover, I can’t thank you enough for imparting such a powerful cultivation technique to me.”

At this point, Kathleen stopped talking.

“Are you the Star Lord of 5901?””

Lin Fan said,” If 5901 is Earth, then it should be me.””

Kathleen was just probing.

After all, Lin Fan and Star Lord 5901 were both extremely powerful. Furthermore, they happened to be in the Four Seasons Cosmos.

However, Kathleen didn’t expect it to really be him!

Kathleen’s heartbeat quickened.

Right now, the person who was the most discussed in the entire universe was undoubtedly Star Lord 5901.

Some people said that he was the strongest expert below the Sacred Master.

There were even people who said that he was the Holy Master.

However, no matter what, his strength was publicly acknowledged.

As for him…He was actually transmitting a message to him?

He had actually guided him in his cultivation in the past?

Thinking of this, Kathleen blushed.

At this moment, Lin Fan said,” Human hearts are hard to predict. If he didn’t want to stay in the Temple of Life anymore, he could consider coming to Earth.”

After saying that, Lin Fan ended the soul communication.

Lin Fan’s figure appeared in her mind.

If he couldn’t stay any longer, he would go to Earth? To Lin Fan’s side?

For some reason, Kathleen’s heart beat faster.

….

On the other side, outside the 33 Heavens.

Tai Ba, who was resting with his eyes closed, suddenly emitted a dense curse black gas. His expression suddenly changed, and he relied on his powerful strength to continuously block it.

However, the power of the curse was too strong.

Gradually, Tai Ba’s face started to twist.

In the next moment, a trickle of blood seeped out from the corner of his mouth.

“Do you really think that I’m so easy to bully? Bastard!” Tai Ba roared towards the sky, causing the Thirty-Three Levels of Heaven to continuously flip.

Then, Tai Ba leaped up and his figure covered the sky, turning the entire world into darkness.

Before long, Tai Ba appeared in the sky above the Buddha Realm.

He saw…

He waved his hand and released a terrifying seven-colored light.

“Hualala!”

Below him, the densely packed Buddhas instantly vaporized and turned into a wisp of green smoke.

“Enemy attack!”

“Namo Amitabha!”

Shouts rose and fell.

However, this had no effect on Tai Ba. Instead, it made him even crazier.

It released an even more majestic seven-colored flowing light, turning even more Buddhas, mountains, and towers into nothingness.

“Whoosh!”

However, it was also because of this that a giant Buddha as tall as the sky appeared in the air.

His eyes were like the sun as he stared at Tai Ba and said,””Tai Ba, why did you kill my disciple and destroy my sect?”

“Why?” Tai Ba asked sternly. Bodhi Fruit, you insidious baldy, you know what you’ve done!”

Clearly, he thought that the Bodhi Fruit was cursing him.

No wonder Tai Ba would think this way.

The Bodhi Fruit was a Karmic Sage.

However, karma and curses went hand in hand.

Among all the Holy Masters, the one with the strongest curse was undoubtedly the Bodhi Fruit.

In addition, Tai Ba clearly remembered that Bodhi Guo had always hated the Monster Race.

Before becoming a Holy Lord, Pu Guo was even known as Demon Subduing Buddha Lord.

Later on, in a mystic realm, Tai Ba had even fought with him.

Even though it had been hundreds of thousands of years.

However, Tai Ba still believed that the curse was caused by the Bodhi Fruit.

As for why there was no curse in the past, it was definitely because the Bodhi Fruit wanted to numb him, or because he had not fully mastered the curse technique.

Bodhi Guo’s face sank slightly as he said,”Tyrant, you’ve gone too far.””

A vigorous energy materialized and spread in all directions.

Obviously, he was really angry.

This was normal…

After all, everyone had a temper.

Moreover, Pu Guo was a high and mighty Holy Master.

Many of his disciples had just been killed, his mountain gate had been destroyed, and he himself had been humiliated in public.

How could he not be angry?

Tai Ba was in a state of madness and was not moved at all.

“Too much?” he shouted fiercely. You haven’t even experienced what’s even worse!”

As soon as he finished speaking, he raised his hand and formed a claw, causing the space within a radius of 10,000 kilometers to instantly shatter like a shadow. The entire world became dense.

Then, he slapped the Bodhi Fruit.

“Boom!”
